title: Design System: Yumna Tyer Orthotics and Prosthetics

headline.purpose: Section headings and the body-area name inside the stage.

headline-compact.purpose: The stage heading inside the pinned viewport; the contact heading sits in the same band.

quote.purpose: The lead sentence of the story panel.

lede.purpose: The hero introduction; 1.2rem on wide screens.

nav.purpose: Top menu links and rail chips.

label.purpose: Pill labels on the portrait and figure hotspots.

shadows.name: photo
shadows.purpose: Portraits sitting on a coloured tile.

shadows.name: dock
shadows.purpose: The fixed dock, with a hairline so it holds on white.

shadows.name: label
shadows.purpose: Hotspot labels and the dock hint.

shadows.name: outline-on-plum
shadows.purpose: Story panel outline on deep plum.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Easing for every transform, entrance and reveal (--ease).

motion.name: colour-change
motion.purpose: Background and colour transitions on hover.

motion.name: panel-enter
motion.purpose: Active body-area panel fades in and rises 14px.

motion.name: card-enter
motion.purpose: Deck card rises 18px in; the outgoing card leaves upward.

motion.name: underline-draw
motion.purpose: Hand-drawn marigold underline draws once when 60% in view.

motion.name: deck-dwell
motion.purpose: Time a product card shows before the deck advances; drives the vertical progress bar.

motion.name: bob
motion.purpose: Portrait labels floating. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: ping
motion.purpose: Hotspot dot ring. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: clip-rate
motion.purpose: Playback rate of the figure clips; hurried when the page has already moved on.

motion.name: step-commit
motion.purpose: When scroll commits the stage to the next body area.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.01ms; no clips; no deck auto-advance; instant scroll

components.html: WhatsApp Yumna

components.description: Small coloured labels in sage, plum and marigold. On the portrait they carry a cursor arrow; on the figure they are hotspot buttons.
components.html: OrthotistProsthetistKnee

components.description: White card with a solid marigold, sage or plum art tile holding a cut-out product illustration.

Hinged knee brace

narrative.overview:
One line-drawn woman carries the page. She stands on a lilac-white ground and moves through eight poses; each pose points at a part of the body, and the supports for that part appear beside her on bright flat tiles. Everything else is built from the same few materials: solid-colour sections, cut-out flat-colour product illustrations, pill-shaped controls, small coloured labels with cursor arrows, a hand-drawn marigold underline and four-point sparkles. The effect is warm and plain-spoken for a clinical subject: nothing glossy, nothing gradient, nothing that looks like a clinic template.

The system is mobile-first and dense only where it has to be. The pinned services stage fits a heading, a body-area rail, the figure, a text panel and one product card into a single small viewport; the sections around it are generous and quiet. Colour is used as surface, not as decoration on text: plum-black ink does the reading, the bright colours sit behind things.

Motion belongs to the figure. Short clips play between neighbouring poses and always run to their end; around her, cards slide a few pixels and labels bob. Everything has a still, fully usable form for visitors who ask for reduced motion or have no JavaScript or WebGL.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac-white ground with solid plum-deep, blush and ink sections; no gradients anywhere.
Marigold, sage and plum tiles behind cut-out product illustrations and behind the portrait.
Young Serif display in two tones (ink plus one coloured phrase), Figtree for everything else.
Pills for anything pressable; soft rounded rectangles for anything that holds content.
Soft plum-tinted drop shadows only on white surfaces that float; tonal layering otherwise.
One pinned stage where scroll position drives the figure's pose, the text panel and the product deck together.
Honest, visibly marked placeholders for content that has not been supplied.

rules.name: The Tile Rule
rules.body: Marigold, sage and mauve are surfaces and marks, never text on the light ground (1.7:1, 2.1:1 and 2.9:1). Marigold and sage carry ink; plum and deep plum carry white.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: A display heading is ink with exactly one phrase in a second tone: rose on light sections, marigold on deep plum.

rules.name: The Solid Section Rule
rules.body: Sections and tiles are one flat colour each. No gradients, no tints fading into each other.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Once Rule
rules.body: Young Serif is for headings, the mission line and one quoted lead. Product names, labels, buttons and navigation are always Figtree.

rules.name: The Inset Outline Rule
rules.body: Edges are drawn with an inset box-shadow, not a border: 2px ink on the quiet button, 1.5px plum at 45% on rail chips, 2px plum at 30% on placeholder cards, 2px white at 16% on the story panel. The only real border in the system is the dashed one that marks content still to be supplied.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is ink (46 31 56) at 45 to 70% with negative spread. Never neutral black, never a spread glow.

dos: Do set reading text in ink or soft ink on ground, white or blush, and white or lilac mist on plum, deep plum and ink.
Do put products and photographs on a solid marigold, sage or plum tile, as cut-outs, with the same radius as the tile.
Do give each display heading one phrase in the second tone: rose on light, marigold on deep plum.
Do make pressable things pills or circles and content holders soft rectangles (1.75rem, 1.25rem, 1rem, 0.5rem).
Do draw outlines with inset box-shadows and keep shadows plum-tinted with negative spread.
Do ease movement with `cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)` and keep UI travel small (2px lifts, 14 to 18px entrances).
Do mark missing content with the dashed todo block, the coming-soon card or the story slot.
Do give every moving thing a still equivalent and gate ambient loops behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do keep the logo intact and unaltered; it is a binding brand asset.
donts: Don't use marigold, sage or mauve as text on the light ground; they fail contrast (1.7:1, 2.1:1, 2.9:1).
Don't use gradients, or blend one section colour into another.
Don't set Young Serif bold, small, or on controls and labels.
Don't interrupt or scrub the figure's clips; a clip always runs to its end.
Don't place the figure with a CSS blend mode; her ground is repainted to the page ground in the shader.
Don't invent testimonials, credentials, outcomes or clinical claims to fill a placeholder.
Don't add a second line-drawn character; the system has one figure.
